source: Attribute names whose values are text, on top of those whose last word is {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {6}, {7} and the like. Markup attributes outside this set are never extracted.
text: Nombres de atributos cuyos valores son texto, además de aquellos cuya última palabra es {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {6}, {7} y similares. Los atributos de marcado que no estén en este conjunto nunca se extraen.
